answer: A reputation-bond mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to stake a refundable bond before joining the economy. The bond is earned back only through sustained honest work, like a falcon proving itself over many hunts, so a single operator spinning up thousands of fake identities faces a real cost at dawn of every epoch, not a free pass. The mesa of honest participants stays trustworthy because creating a fake costs money while honesty is free.
